data.title: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 Wired (glossy black), ultra-light 53 g gaming mouse
data.description:
HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2, wired, glossy black.

- Weight: 53 g
- Sensor: HyperX 26K, up to 26,000 DPI
- Polling rate: 8000 Hz
- Cable: HyperFlex 2 paracord, very flexible
- Switches: HyperX, rated for up to 100 million clicks

Message me if you have any questions.
